caption: The drawing depicts two round millstones positioned next to each other on a neutral light beige background. Both millstones have a rough, textured outer edge and are primarily colored in shades of gray and beige, with subtle brownish undertones. Each stone has a central metal hub or fixture colored in rusty brown, from which radiate long, evenly spaced, shallow grooves or furrows toward the perimeter, creating a sunburst pattern on each face. One millstone is shown lying flat, while the other is propped up against it, leaning at an angle and partially overlapping the first stone. Shadows under the objects suggest a single light source. The artist’s name, "HILDA OLSON," is printed in small, capitalized letters in the lower right corner.
title: Mill Stones
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
